seed_prompt: Create a business scenario for a large regional hospital system with one core service.

ops.business_description: A multi-facility regional hospital system providing inpatient care, outpatient procedures, diagnostic services, and surgical services from hospital and ambulatory sites.
ops.customer_type: Patients, commercial insurance plans, Medicare, Medicaid, employer health plans, and referring physicians.
ops.products_confirmed: Yes, track Procedure as the single core service.
ops.delivery_method: All procedures are delivered on-site in owned and leased hospital, outpatient, diagnostic, and surgical facilities.
ops.fulfillment_confirmation: Yes, all service delivery is on-site through staffed medical facilities and clinical operating rooms.
ops.sales_channel: Physician referrals, payer network contracts, direct patient scheduling, emergency department intake, outpatient clinic referrals, and employer health plan relationships.
ops.geography: Dallas-Fort Worth metro area and nearby North Texas counties.
ops.growth_lever: Growth is driven by completed procedure volume, operating room utilization, referral capture, payer network access, and outpatient service-line expansion.
ops.competitive_advantage: Regional brand recognition, advanced clinical capability, high procedure capacity, payer relationships, and a broad referral network.
ops.goal_12_months: Reach 900 completed medical procedures per week within 12 months while maintaining safe clinical throughput and care quality.

milestones.description: Reach 900 completed medical procedures per week while maintaining safe clinical throughput and care quality.

ops.confirmation: Yes, the operating model, service, capacity, geography, growth lever, and milestone are correct.

products.unit_definition: One completed medical procedure for one patient, including surgical or procedural care episode.
products.capacity: At full capacity the system can complete 900 medical procedures per week.

market.income_range: Household income of 50000 and above, plus patients covered by commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, or employer health plans.
market.education: Mixed education levels, including high school, trade, college, graduate, and professional education.
market.employment_mix: Working adults, retirees, unemployed patients with coverage, public-sector employees, private-sector employees, and self-employed professionals.
market.confirmation: Yes, the target market profile is correct.

people.owner_background: The executive owner group has 18 years of healthcare administration experience, including hospital operations, payer contracting, compliance oversight, clinical staffing, and multi-site management.
people.other_key_people: The business has 120 employees: 18 physicians and surgeons, 42 nurses and clinical staff, 16 diagnostic and procedure technicians, 12 patient intake and scheduling staff, 10 billing and revenue-cycle staff, 8 facility and supply-chain staff, 8 administrators, and 6 senior managers.
people.confirmation: Yes, the leadership and staffing context is correct.

financials.cogs: Use 86872500 for Year-1 COGS, equal to 55% of 157950000 revenue.
financials.payroll: Use 42000000 for annual payroll across 120 employees.
financials.payroll_detail: Annual payroll is 42000000 for 120 employees across physicians, nurses, technicians, scheduling, billing, facilities, administration, and management.

financials.other_monthly_debt_payments: Use 20000 for other monthly debt payments.
financials.initial_lease: Use 10000 for monthly lease expense beyond main rent.
